Name: Zeruiah
Role: Mother of Joab, Abishai and Asahel
Summary: Zeruiah is named as the mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel, David's three nephews and fiercest warriors. Her sister Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whom Joab murdered.
KeyStory: Zeruiah mothered the three brothers who commanded David's wars.
RelatedPeople: Joab; Abishai; Asahel; Abigail, Daughter of Nahash; Jesse
LifeLesson: A mother's sons can become a king's sword — for good and for ill.
